decisions.reason: As a product launched only in 2023 and still given its own page, the spotlight would likely be kept while management waits for clearer performance signals, with only a modest risk of withdrawal if it falls short of early aspirations in this niche segment.

As a recently launched core lighting product that was still actively presented in 2023, the ceiling luminaire would likely be retained because management would usually allow more time and organisational slack before reallocating resources absent clear underperformance.
